message: In and of itself, despair won't get us anywhere.  Hell, if I wanted to live out my days completely miserable, I'd have stuck to interviewing insurance claimants.  So maybe (just maybe) we could do with less comp-laining in some cases, although I'd be reluctant to support this poster as a quick-panacea banner--too individualistic with it's uni-theme, singularity, etc. Fine lines, as well, separate critique of conditions that proliferate hardship and the lament that frames the teaching of writing in simplistic (or whiney) terms as contemptible work.
